sources.snippet: Vicuna 13B v1.5 16K - GGUF Model creator: lmsys Original model: Vicuna 13B v1.5 16K Description This repo contains GGUF format model files for lmsys's Vicuna 13B v1.5 16K. About GGUF GGUF is a new format introduced by the llama.cpp team on August 21st 2023. It is a replacement for GGML, which is no longer supported by llama.cpp.
